title: Shuttle Result (out)
description: What one confirm wrote, in one transaction, and what rested as Seeds (D2, D9).

item_id.description: The packet item_id or idea_id/adjacency_id this row resolves, for client-side reconciliation.

written_as.description: The model this became (D4), e.g. tapestry.Place, commons.CommonsItem, classifications.Tag, relations.Relationship, commons.LeafEntry.

rested_as_seed.description: item_ids left unticked, or ticked without a story: written as writing.Seed rows, not asked about again (D9).
